title: Simple Cayley permutations
summary: We propose a notion of simplicity for Cayley permutations that is compatible with inflation and agrees, under a natural relational encoding, with indecomposability in the sense of Schmerl and Trotter. We establish a substitution decomposition analogous to that of permutations, in which the components are modules of the associated relational structure. We use it to enumerate simple Cayley permutations as well as simple restricted growth functions.
